name: aiops-hooks
description: Claude Code hooks shared by the AiOps Community: guardrails, formatters and session helpers, each installable on its own.

plugins.name: claude-md-maintainer
plugins.description: Stop hook that collects candidate CLAUDE.md lines into a local, git-excluded inbox, plus a skill that verifies them against the codebase, prunes stale lines and enforces a size budget.

plugins.name: git-guardrails
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that blocks irreversible git operations: force pushes to protected branches, hard resets over uncommitted work, protected branch deletion, untracked file wipes and history rewrites.

plugins.name: project-checks
plugins.description: PostToolUse hook that runs the formatter or linter a project already defines on the file just edited, returning failures so they are fixed in the same turn. Runs only inside directories you mark as trusted.
